Occurrences.Kwic: 溪於是伏膺，作園頭三載。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X81/X81n1571.xml). Complete Five Lamps (Vols. 1–33) (五燈全書(第1卷-第33卷)): Complete Moshan Liaoran case: the biographer reports that Guanxi Zhixian submitted and served as garden steward for three years. Guanxi is the office holder, not the utterer of the title.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 溪於是伏膺，作園頭三載 is biographical narration: Guanxi Zhixian becomes the garden steward for three years after yielding to Moshan Liaoran.

Occurrences.Kwic: 賣身王老難為價，貴賤俱非不易酬，若使當時無退悔，喚來分付與園頭。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X66/X66n1297.xml). Grove of the Mirror of the School (宗鑑法林): The verse author is unnamed: Grove of the Mirror of the School, complete commentarial verse: an unnamed verse author says to call him over and hand him to the garden steward. Nanquan Puyuan is the alluded-to case figure, not the verse's utterer.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: The complete stored unit is an unattributed commentarial verse; its 王老 alludes to Nanquan, but the headword occurs in the verse author's own final line.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X81/X81n1568.xml). Strict Lineage of the Five Lamps (Vols. 10–25) (五燈嚴統(第10卷-第25卷)): Complete Nanyuan Huiyong exchange: Nanyuan directly asks the unnamed garden steward whether the gourds have flowered; the steward answers before Nanyuan continues and strikes.

Source record (X/X83/X83n1578.xml). Record Pointing at the Moon (指月錄): Record of Pointing at the Moon, complete Yaoshan case: the compiler identifies an unnamed garden steward planting vegetables; Yaoshan Weiyan then questions him. The title is narrator-owned.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 園頭栽菜次 is the narrator's stage setting: an unnamed garden steward is planting vegetables when Yaoshan questions him.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X68/X68n1319.xml). Imperially Selected Recorded Sayings (御選語錄): Complete Yulin Tongxiu exchange: the narrator labels the unnamed garden steward before his question about Yulin's illness. Yulin answers that he is in the steward's garden every day.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 園頭問 is a dialogue cue identifying the unnamed garden steward as questioner; his spoken words begin after the cue. Yulin Tongxiu supplies both replies.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師問園頭：匏子開花也未？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X79/X79n1557.xml). Essential Compendium of the United Lamp (聯燈會要): Complete Nanyuan Huiyong exchange: Nanyuan directly asks the unnamed garden steward whether the gourds have flowered; the steward answers before Nanyuan continues and strikes.

Senses.Explanation: The garden steward is the monastery officer responsible for cultivated grounds and their produce. The monastic code lists the title among the lower offices; encounter records show Guanxi Zhixian serving in the post, an unnamed steward planting vegetables under Yaoshan, Nanyuan questioning a steward about gourds, and Yulin answering one in the garden. These uses make the office part of the laboring and interview life of the monastery, not merely a generic gardener outside it.
